# DeployVet

> DeployVet is a pre-launch security and bug check for web apps built with AI and no-code tools (Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, v0, Bubble) and apps with Supabase backends. Made by Hayden Young. Formerly called Launch Guard. It is not a penetration test.

## What it checks
- DeployVet Free Check: an outside-only scan of the public URL. Covers exposed keys in the JS bundle, the Supabase anon key with a Row Level Security probe, security headers, open admin/API routes, mixed content and broken pages.
- DeployVet Scan: everything above plus a read-only check of the repo or Supabase project the user connects, and copy-paste fix prompts for their builder.
- Owners verify their domain with a DNS TXT record or a meta tag. DeployVet only checks sites the user owns.

## Pricing (USD)
- DeployVet Free Check: $0. One outside scan per verified site each month. Shows the score, issue counts and full detail for the most serious issue.
- DeployVet Scan: $7 one-time. Paid up front, then the scan runs.
- DeployVet Pro: $15/month or $150/year, billed up front. Weekly scans with email alerts and scan history. Cancel any time.

## Who it is for
- Non-technical founders and solo makers shipping with AI builders
- Indie hackers using Cursor or v0 with Supabase
- Agencies shipping AI-built apps for clients

## Who it is not for
- Teams that need a formal penetration test, compliance attestation or legal security sign-off
